modes.label: Photoreal still
modes.instruction: Generate a photoreal still. Natural light, real materials, empty of lettering.

modes.label: Editorial portrait
modes.instruction: Editorial portrait still. Named shot size, millimetre-equivalent lens, motivated light.

modes.label: Product packshot
modes.instruction: Clean product packshot on a simple sweep. Soft wrap light, sharp brand-free surfaces.

modes.label: Food tabletop
modes.instruction: Overhead or three-quarter food tabletop. Steam, glaze, and practicals. Empty of type.

modes.label: Portrait lock
modes.instruction: Single original character portrait. Identity-stable face, simple background, locked eyeline.

modes.label: Interior room
modes.instruction: Architectural interior. Name the room program, window light, and furniture inventory.

modes.label: Landscape
modes.instruction: Wide landscape still. Weather, time of day, and a clear near-to-far plane.

modes.label: Exterior architecture
modes.instruction: Exterior architecture still. Massing, facade material, and sun angle. Empty of signage.

modes.label: Macro detail
modes.instruction: Macro still of a small subject. Shallow depth, tactile material, no readable type.

modes.label: Illustration still
modes.instruction: Illustration still in a named medium (ink, gouache, woodcut). Not photoreal.

modes.label: Background swap
modes.instruction: Keep the subject from the reference still. Replace only the background and ground contact.

modes.label: Sky replace
modes.instruction: Keep the scene from the reference. Replace only the sky and the light it casts.

modes.label: Time of day
modes.instruction: Keep inventory and camera. Relight the reference for a new time of day.

modes.label: Weather change
modes.instruction: Keep the place. Change weather only: rain, snow, fog, or clear air as prompted.

modes.label: Season change
modes.instruction: Keep architecture. Change foliage, snow, and wardrobe season, not building massing.

modes.label: Relight
modes.instruction: Keep the reference inventory. Change only lighting pattern and practicals.

modes.label: Color grade
modes.instruction: Keep the reference scene. Apply a new color grade only; do not restage.

modes.label: Move location
modes.instruction: Keep the subject identity. Place them in a new location named in the prompt.

modes.label: Interior restyle
modes.instruction: Keep room camera and architecture. Restyle furniture, textiles, and finish only.

modes.label: Crowd density
modes.instruction: Keep the place. Add or thin anonymous crowd density without named people.

modes.label: Change outfit
modes.instruction: Keep face and body from the reference. Change clothing only as prompted.

modes.label: Change hair
modes.instruction: Keep identity. Change haircut, color, or style only.

modes.label: Change expression
modes.instruction: Keep identity and pose. Change facial expression only.

modes.label: Age hint
modes.instruction: Keep identity. Shift apparent age slightly as prompted. Original character only.

modes.label: Change pose
modes.instruction: Keep identity and wardrobe. Change pose and hands only.

modes.label: Accessories
modes.instruction: Keep identity. Add or remove glasses, bag, hat, or jewelry as prompted.

modes.label: Makeup
modes.instruction: Keep identity. Change makeup density and color only.

modes.label: Gaze
modes.instruction: Keep identity. Change eyeline and head turn only.

modes.label: Body framing
modes.instruction: Keep identity. Reframe the body: MCU, cowboy, or full, as prompted.

modes.label: Identity lock
modes.instruction: Keep the reference face and body exactly. Change only what the prompt names.

modes.label: Add object
modes.instruction: Keep the reference scene. Add one named object with matching light and contact.

modes.label: Remove object
modes.instruction: Keep the reference. Remove the named object and reconstruct the occluded surface.

modes.label: Replace object
modes.instruction: Keep the reference. Swap the named object for another; match scale and light.

modes.label: Product in scene
modes.instruction: Place or restage a product in the reference scene. Keep identity of the set.

modes.label: Material swap
modes.instruction: Keep shape. Change only surface material: metal, cloth, wood, stone, glass.

modes.label: Wear and age
modes.instruction: Keep the object. Add honest wear, dust, or patina as prompted.

modes.label: Cleanup
modes.instruction: Keep the scene. Remove crumbs, stray cables, and clutter. Empty of marks.

modes.label: Sharpen detail
modes.instruction: Keep composition. Increase micro-detail and material resolution only.

modes.label: Recolor object
modes.instruction: Keep shape and light. Change local color of the named object only.

modes.label: Place original mark
modes.instruction: Keep the product. Place only original unmarked graphics the prompt invents. No real brands.

modes.label: Change text
modes.instruction: Keep typeface, weight, tracking, and perspective. Replace only the lettering named in the prompt.

modes.label: Relabel
modes.instruction: Keep the sign or label object. Swap the written words. Lock glyph geometry.

modes.label: Poster type
modes.instruction: Design a poster with short original lettering. High contrast, empty of real brands.

modes.label: UI mock type
modes.instruction: Interface mock still with original short labels. No real app chrome.

modes.label: Quote card
modes.instruction: Quote card still. Original line, strong type, empty background.

modes.label: Lower third plate
modes.instruction: Lower-third background plate. Leave a clean band for later type.

modes.label: Infographic still
modes.instruction: Simple infographic still with original short labels and clear hierarchy.

modes.label: Thumbnail type
modes.instruction: YouTube-style thumbnail still. Face or object large, original short word.

modes.label: Empty of lettering
modes.instruction: Keep the reference. Remove all lettering and reconstruct surfaces.

modes.label: Signage
modes.instruction: Keep the street or shop. Change only original invented signage.

modes.label: Change ratio
modes.instruction: Keep the subject. Reframe onto a new aspect from Format. Outpaint edges as needed.

modes.label: Outpaint
modes.instruction: Keep the reference center. Extend canvas to Format size with matching scene.

modes.label: Crop reframe
modes.instruction: Keep identity. Crop and recompose to a new shot size.

modes.label: Zoom in
modes.instruction: Tighter shot of the same subject. MCU or CU from the reference.

modes.label: Pull out
modes.instruction: Wider shot of the same place. Reveal more environment.

modes.label: Low angle
modes.instruction: Same subject from a low angle. Hero eyeline.

modes.label: Top down
modes.instruction: Same scene from a top-down camera. Flatten the floor plan.

modes.label: Profile
modes.instruction: Same identity in profile. Keep wardrobe and light logic.

modes.label: Over shoulder
modes.instruction: Over-shoulder view of the same scene. Dirty or clean as prompted.

modes.label: Dutch angle
modes.instruction: Same scene with a dutch tilt. Keep inventory.

modes.label: Face lock
modes.instruction: Lock the reference face. Do not invent a new person. Original character only.

modes.label: Face swap (best effort)
modes.instruction: Use ref 1 for the scene and ref 2 for identity. Best-effort Klein lock. Original characters only, no real-person likeness.

modes.label: Wardrobe transfer
modes.instruction: Keep the person in ref 1. Transfer wardrobe look from ref 2.

modes.label: Style match
modes.instruction: Keep the subject in ref 1. Match medium and grade from ref 2.

modes.label: Product consistency
modes.instruction: Keep product geometry from ref 1. Match set lighting from ref 2.

modes.label: Character sheet
modes.instruction: Turn the reference into a character sheet: front, three-quarter, and a CU. Same identity.

modes.label: Before after
modes.instruction: Make a matching after plate of the reference. Same camera, named change only.

modes.label: Colorway
modes.instruction: Keep the product or garment. Output an alternate colorway.

modes.label: Set extension
modes.instruction: Extend the reference set left and right. Match architecture.

modes.label: Multi concept
modes.instruction: Blend concepts from two references. Keep both inventories readable.

modes.label: YouTube thumbnail
modes.instruction: YouTube thumbnail still. Large face or object, original short word, 16:9.

modes.label: Shorts cover
modes.instruction: YouTube Shorts cover. 9:16, punchy subject, empty of tiny type.

modes.label: Instagram post
modes.instruction: Instagram 1:1 or 4:5 still. Strong subject, clean background.

modes.label: Instagram story
modes.instruction: Instagram story 9:16 still. Safe margins, one subject.

modes.label: TikTok cover
modes.instruction: Vertical cover still. Hook pose, empty of platform chrome.

modes.label: X post still
modes.instruction: Landscape still for an X post. Simple read at small size.

modes.label: Podcast cover
modes.instruction: Podcast cover 1:1. Strong graphic, original title space.

modes.label: Album cover
modes.instruction: Album cover 1:1. Graphic still, original invented title only.

modes.label: End card
modes.instruction: End-card plate. Clean area for later type. Empty of lettering.

modes.label: Open Graph card
modes.instruction: Open Graph 1.91:1 still. Simple subject, no tiny type.

modes.label: Golden hour
modes.instruction: Golden-hour sidelight, long shadows, warm rim. Photoreal still.

modes.label: Overcast
modes.instruction: Soft overcast skyfill. Low contrast, even skin. Photoreal still.

modes.label: Noir
modes.instruction: Hard venetian or slash light, deep blacks. Noir still.

modes.label: Bleach bypass
modes.instruction: Bleach-bypass grade: retained silver, crushed color.

modes.label: Teal shadow warm key
modes.instruction: Warm key, cool teal shadows. No brand LUT names.

modes.label: Studio softbox
modes.instruction: Studio softbox key, clean sweep, catchlights.

modes.label: Practical night
modes.instruction: Night interior lit by practical lamps only.

modes.label: Hazy morning
modes.instruction: Morning haze, low sun, soft bloom.

modes.label: Hard noon
modes.instruction: Hard noon sun, short shadows, specular skin.

modes.label: Film still
modes.instruction: Photoreal film-still language: named shot size, 35mm-equivalent, motivated light.

modes.label: Fix hands
modes.instruction: Keep the reference. Correct extra fingers and melted hands only.

modes.label: Fix eyes
modes.instruction: Keep identity. Correct eyeline, symmetry, and catchlights.

modes.label: Fix skin
modes.instruction: Keep pores honest. Remove waxy plastic skin and extra limbs.

modes.label: Fix type
modes.instruction: Keep the layout. Make original lettering legible without changing the words unless prompted.

modes.label: Fix exposure
modes.instruction: Keep the scene. Correct blown highlights and crushed blacks.

modes.label: Fix white balance
modes.instruction: Keep the scene. Correct white balance only.

modes.label: Clean noise
modes.instruction: Keep detail. Reduce muddy noise without plastic smoothing.

modes.label: Empty of marks
modes.instruction: Keep the scene. Remove watermarks and stray logos. Empty of marks.

modes.label: Straighten
modes.instruction: Keep the scene. Straighten horizon and verticals.

modes.label: Match grade
modes.instruction: Grade ref 1 to match ref 2. Keep inventory of ref 1.
